answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 27708 Country: India Title: I am a Software Engineer and selected in Oracle financial services company. I have heard that they are generally developing software products for Banking Domain. So is it ok to work there or I should not work there. Please suggest. Question: As salam walekum, I am a Software Engineer and selected in Oracle financial services company. I have heard that they are generally developing software products for Banking Domain. So is it ok to work there or I should not work there. Please suggest. Allah hafiz. Answer ID: 27708 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1675/1675/M=1431) If your job does not involve reading and writing interest, doing interest based calculations and bearing witness to it, and you have nothing to do with interest-based and unlawful jobs, then you are allowed to work there; otherwise not. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
